mapper.select: WITH Averaged AS ( SELECT ol.ProductId AS ProductId, ol.LineNumber AS LineNumber, ol.UnitPrice AS UnitPrice, AVG(ol.UnitPrice) OVER (PARTITION BY ol.ProductId) AS AveragePrice FROM {{schema}}.ShopOrderLines AS ol) SELECT a.ProductId AS ProductId, a.LineNumber AS LineNumber, a.UnitPrice AS UnitPrice, a.AveragePrice AS AveragePrice FROM Averaged AS a WHERE a.UnitPrice > a.AveragePrice
